How to Set Up

Setup is easy — just 3 steps.

From install to first use, it takes just a few minutes.

1

Add It From the Store

Open the “Backlog My Tasks” page on the Chrome Web Store and click “Add to Chrome”

2

Space URL and API Key

Right-click the extension icon → Options → enter your space URL and API key (up to 10 spaces supported)

3

Click the icon!

Click the toolbar icon → your tasks appear in a list, ready to use right away

💡 Getting your API key: Backlog → Personal Settings → API → click “Register” to issue one

Let's get started today!

You'll open Backlog a lot less. Task management and team progress tracking — all in one place. Install it now and make it your everyday companion.
